title: Leju Robotics puts 15 humanoids on an auto parts loading line, reporting about 98% success
machine_does: 15 Leju humanoid robots pick wheel hub bearings and load parts in routine operation at auto parts maker Zhaofeng's plant in Hangzhou.
why_it_matters: Shows humanoids doing steady paid factory work, not only demos.
date_checked: Article text says the two firms presented the solution at the factory on 15 Oct; page metadata publishedDate 2026-10-16T02:45Z.

title: Faraday Future unveils $2,490 Nova and $299 Nova Mini humanoid robots
machine_does: Faraday Future and FFR launch the FF Nova humanoid at $2,490 and a $299 Nova Mini for a developer and school programme.
why_it_matters: A humanoid priced like a laptop pulls the technology toward ordinary buyers and students.
date_checked: Page metadata 2026-10-16T00:08Z; press release carried by several outlets 15-16 Oct; title only read in full, price from headline (body not fully extracted).

title: Agility chooses Nyobolt ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
machine_does: Agility Robotics picks Nyobolt batteries so its next-generation Digit 5 humanoid can recharge in about 9 minutes and work over 20 hours a day.
why_it_matters: Charging time decides whether humanoids can run in shifts at a warehouse.
date_checked: Google RSS pubDate 2026-10-15T11:03Z; same news carried by Investing.com, Unite.AI, Stock Titan inside the window; article page blocked by Cloudflare, figures from Stock Titan headline.

title: Chinese startup DexForce trains humanoid robots using virtual data to slash costs
machine_does: DexForce uses simulated data to teach humanoid robots tasks, used by Toyota, Samsung and Foxconn, valued around 1.4 billion dollars.
why_it_matters: Cheaper training data is one of the main costs holding humanoids back.
date_checked: Reuters URL dated 2026-10-15, RSS pubDate 07:47Z; Reuters page needs JavaScript so facts read from domain-b (15 Oct); the funding round itself was announced in June, so only the Reuters report is new.

title: RoboParty launches RP1, a full-stack open-source humanoid
machine_does: RoboParty releases the RP1 humanoid with open hardware and software for education and research.
why_it_matters: An open humanoid lets universities and small teams build on it without a big company.
date_checked: Google RSS pubDate 2026-10-15T17:00Z, PR Newswire release id 20261015; page blocked (403), content not read in full.

title: Hyundai Motor Group sets up a robotics business strategy team
machine_does: Hyundai Motor Group launches a dedicated team to set global robotics strategy, including production and sales of the Atlas humanoid.
why_it_matters: One of the world's biggest carmakers is organising to sell humanoids, not only use them.
date_checked: Article URL dated 2026/10/15, RSS pubDate 06:40Z; text read.

title: Origin raises $20M to scale autonomous construction robots
machine_does: Origin's OG-1 robot autonomously applies compound, sands and primes drywall on construction sites; target 150 robots deployed by end of 2027.
why_it_matters: Robots start doing finishing work on building sites, where labour is short.
date_checked: Page date 15 October 2026, 2026-10-15T20:35Z; text read; also Economic Times, Livemint, Business Standard in window.

title: Ultra raises $62M to expand its AI-powered warehouse packing robots
machine_does: Ultra's OP1 robot packs orders in US warehouses (over 500,000 packed); funding includes a $50M Series A led by Framework with Y Combinator.
why_it_matters: Warehouse packing robots sold as a subscription are now past the pilot stage.

title: Food delivery robot makers Coco and Serve hit with biometric privacy lawsuits in Chicago
machine_does: Sidewalk delivery robots are accused of scanning faces, hands and bodies of passers-by without consent; both firms deny it.
why_it_matters: First big privacy test for robots that roam public sidewalks.
date_checked: RSS pubDate 2026-10-15T22:20Z; also Chicago Tribune 16 Oct 00:14Z, CBS News 03:25Z, Bloomberg Law 18:53Z; article text read (lawsuit filing, company statements).

title: Korean Army unveils robot-led battle drills for 2040 warfare
machine_does: The Army ran a live drill where drones, unmanned ground vehicles and a laser air-defence weapon cleared a minefield and an enemy position ahead of soldiers.
why_it_matters: Shows how a shrinking army plans to put machines at the front.
date_checked: URL dated 2026/10/15, RSS pubDate 05:30Z; text read.

title: Ukrainian combat robots to be built in Canada: Tencore and Dominion Dynamics sign deal
machine_does: Ukraine's Tencore signs a memorandum to produce its TerMIT ground combat robots in Canada from 2027, with an Arctic version.
why_it_matters: Ukrainian battlefield robots move into Western production lines.

title: AP gets first look at StarGate, Ukraine's first aerial drone to evacuate wounded soldiers
machine_does: Ukraine tests StarGate, an uncrewed aerial vehicle meant to lift wounded soldiers off the front line.
why_it_matters: A robot rescue use of drones that could save lives.
date_checked: RSS pubDate 2026-10-16T03:36Z; AP exclusive also carried by SMH 00:57Z and AOL 15 Oct 18:16Z; page not read (empty fetch).
